label: Quiet Playful
difference_from_d: A small current of playful mischief in the comic beats while preserving D's quiet warmth and natural delivery.

parameters.voice_description: An original English-speaking mascot voice for Merc, an ageless liquid-metal adventure sprite who reads as a young adult. Soft and androgynous with a clear intimate register, gentle warmth, quiet wonder, an easy unhurried rhythm and subtle playful mischief tucked into comic beats. Lightly melodic and whimsical while remaining natural, intelligible and emotionally present. Crisp articulation for short game dialogue. Dry, close-mic studio recording with excellent audio quality; no music, background sound or reverb. Moderate-to-soft conversational volume, never shouting. A friendly encouraging coach, never mugging, wispy, sleepy, childish, squeaky, shrill, announcer-like or imitative.
